scripts.clean: npm --prefix core run clean && npm --prefix react run clean && npm --prefix react-native run clean
scripts.build: npm --prefix core run build && npm --prefix react run build && npm --prefix react-native run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix core run typecheck && npm --prefix react run typecheck && npm --prefix react-native run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix core test && npm --prefix react test && npm --prefix react-native test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix core run test:coverage && npm --prefix react run test:coverage && npm --prefix react-native run test:coverage
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:coverage
